rows.label: Sahara
rows.hook: is the largest hot expanse of sand and rock on Earth, nearly as big as a continent

rows.label: Atacama Desert
rows.hook: is the driest non-polar place on Earth, where rain almost never falls

rows.label: Gobi Desert
rows.hook: is a cold, rocky expanse where dinosaur fossils and eggs have been unearthed

rows.label: Sinai Peninsula
rows.hook: sits between two seas and forms a bridge between two continents

rows.label: Mojave Desert
rows.hook: is home to Death Valley, one of the hottest places on Earth

rows.label: Sonoran Desert
rows.description: desert in northwestern Mexico and the southwestern United States
rows.hook: is famous for its towering saguaro cacti with upraised arms

rows.label: Taklamakan
rows.description: desert in Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, China
rows.hook: is a vast sea of shifting sand dunes along the ancient Silk Road

rows.label: Thar Desert
rows.description: large, arid region in India and Pakistan
rows.hook: stretches along the border between two South Asian nations, dotted with sand dunes

rows.label: Kalahari Desert
rows.hook: is home to red sand dunes and hardy wildlife like meerkats

rows.label: Rub' al Khali
rows.hook: is one of the largest continuous stretches of sand on Earth, nearly the size of France
